intent: Build recommendation for desktop PC with great cooling/ventilation, enough ports, and neutral case color.
suggested_solution: Recommended build: AMD Ryzen 5 7600 3.8 GHz 6-Core Processor, ASRock B650M Pro RS WiFi Micro ATX AM5 Motherboard, TEAMGROUP T-Force Vulcan 32 GB (2 x 16 GB) DDR5-6000 CL30 Memory, TEAMGROUP MP44 2 TB M.2-2280 PCIe 4.0 X4 NVME Solid State Drive, PowerColor Fighter Radeon RX 6750 XT 12 GB Video Card, BitFenix Flow ATX Mid Tower Case (or alternative options), MSI MAG A750GL PCIE5 750 W 80+ Gold Certified Fully Modular ATX Power Supply
